> AURA is a compact, jewelry-like wearable pendant designed to collect physiological and motion data using optical sensing and an IMU, then send the data to a companion app for visualization and experimental analysis. This warm-up focuses on the electronics architecture, sensor integration, data pipeline, and early enclosure concept. The current prototype uses an ESP32, MAX30102 PPG sensor, and MPU6050 IMU. The long-term goal is to develop a compact custom PCB and 3D-printed pendant enclosure
